cinematic.palette_and_material: Warm archival paper, deep ink, teal record continuity, amber only for correction or supersession, archival glass/vellum/mineral materials.
prohibitions: database cylinder, cloud, brain, or generic AI glow
generated text, UI, faces, hands, or avatars
correction as the entire brand story
cinematic.semantics: A durable record graph receives distinct create, retrieve, and update operations while provenance, relationships, and prior state remain intact; correction propagates without erasing history.

delivery.hero: One silent 8-second 4:3 master, 720p or better, with H.264 and VP9/AV1 web encodes; each hero asset under 1.8 MB.
delivery.responsive: Provide 16:9 desktop and art-directed 9:16 mobile crops without losing the semantic beat.
delivery.sections: Five-to-six-second silent 16:9 masters or still-led micro-loops; target under 900 KB per moving web asset and under 150 KB per AVIF poster.

anti_patterns: Never expose internal record IDs, entity types, field or decision keys, code-call names, repository filenames, phase bookkeeping, or agent instructions on a public page.

Do not paste research analysis, source citations, or implementation-review notes into public prose. Keep detailed evidence in linked source artifacts and translate it into a short reader-facing proof statement.
Do not turn the provenance rail into developer marginalia. Every visible label must be understandable to a cold external reader without product-internal vocabulary.
Do not spread the correction color as a general accent; reserve it for a superseded value or correction event.
Do not rely on animation to communicate source, version, correction, disagreement, or refresh; reduced-motion and static views must remain complete.
Do not diverge shared structural tokens from Ateles without a product reason; the products remain siblings through spacing, restraint, and hierarchy.
Do not reuse the Neotoma app or Inspector palette. Public product pages keep their distinct paper, ink, teal, and correction system.
visual_styles.camera: Locked or slow macro dolly with layered parallax that reveals lineage and relationship depth while persistent geometry stays registered.
visual_styles.composition: Cinematic graph fields dominate, with calm copy-safe negative space. Supporting diagrams may clarify lineage and mechanism but do not replace cinematic identity.
visual_styles.light: Soft museum darkness, raking daylight, restrained volumetric dust; the graph feels durable rather than digital vapor.
visual_styles.material: Archival glass, translucent vellum, engraved paper fiber, mineral record tiles, and fine tensioned teal paths.
visual_styles.motion: Create adds a durable object and relationship; retrieve selectively illuminates without changing state; update adds a current layer while the prior layer remains visible.

palette.rationale: Paper/ink metaphor (not a generic accent-on-white SaaS scheme): a record's oldest technology is the page. Teal retained as seed hue from the current live palette (evolutionary, not a rebrand) but restructured. 'correction' is a NEW semantic color role, reserved exclusively for showing a superseded value struck through beside its replacement (signature move 4) — never reused as a UI accent, so it stays unambiguous.

wcag_aa_verified_2026_09_21.method: relative-luminance WCAG contrast formula computed directly (python), all 10 pairs exceed 4.5:1 AA-normal-text threshold, none borderline

symbol.guidance: Typed records and durable relationships remain connected to sources, prior versions, and distinct agent operations.
symbol.name: Persistent record graph
symbol.secondary: Correction, disagreement, and refresh are events within the graph, not replacement symbols.

typography.code_font_family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace (KEPT as family; assigned to public record labels)
typography.google_fonts_licence: All three (Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono) are free, open-license Google Fonts already loaded via the current font mechanism; no licensing action is needed.
typography.heading_font_family: Fraunces, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif (KEPT from current live page)
typography.rationale: Family kept deliberately: research checked 2026-09-21 (fontsinuse.com/typefaces/171187/jetbrains-mono and designmd.app/library/fraunces-typography) supports Fraunces as a warm editorial face and JetBrains Mono as a credible technical companion. Their public roles are distinct: Fraunces gives durable statements a sense of permanence; JetBrains Mono carries short, plain-language record labels such as source, date, version, correction, and status. It must not display internal IDs, schema names, field keys, mechanism calls, or repo filenames.

avoid: claims that correction is the entire product
grammar: Use agents as concrete actors that create, retrieve, and update.
Use current, prior, sourced, corrected, and reviewed as reader-recognizable state language.
Prefer one declarative claim followed by one compact explanation.
rules: Lead with authoritative shared record, not fear of forgetting.
Explain truth over time through source, version, correction, disagreement, refresh, and continuity.
Use short proof statements and concrete agent operations.
State boundaries honestly: retrieval is useful but is not record authority.
